Question 2
?

The region enclosed by the curves y=8x and y=−x4 for x∈[−2,0] is rotated 2π radians about the line y=1. Which of the following gives the volume of the resulting solid?

a
π∫−20([8x−x4]2−1)dx
b
π∫−20([1−8x]2−[1+x4]2)dx
c
π∫−20(1+8x−x4)2dx
d
π∫−20(x4−8x)2dx
e
π∫−20([8x+1]2−[x4+1]2)dx
Submit
